title: Gaussian CDF band measure bound
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a finite measure space, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ push $\mu$ forward to the standard Gaussian probability measure. For any measurable set $A\subseteq\Omega$ and $a,b\in[0,1]$ with $a\le b$, the difference between the measures of $A\cap\{\omega:\Phi(X(\omega))\le b\}$ and $A\cap\{\omega:\Phi(X(\omega))\le a\}$ is at most $b-a$.
hypotheses_covered: $(\Omega,\mu)$ is a measurable space with finite measure
$X$ is measure-preserving from $\mu$ to standard Gaussian measure
